notes: BUB1B compound heterozygote. Variant 1 (c.2210T>G, p.Leu737Ter) is a known stop-gained variant classified Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic in ClinVar (VCV000533901, rs759242053), gnomAD AF ~7.9e-5, cited in the founding BUB1B-MVA paper (Hanks et al. 2004, PMID 15475955). Variant 2 (c.3006T>G, p.Asn1002Lys) is a novel missense absent from gnomAD, predicted deleterious (SIFT 0.01) and probably damaging (PolyPhen 0.997). Both are heterozygous in the proband; trans configuration is assumed (singleton WGS, no parental samples, no read-backed phasing at these positions) but not directly confirmed. BUB1B biallelic loss-of-function causes Mosaic Variegated Aneuploidy type 1 / PCS syndrome (autosomal recessive), matching the proband's phenotype (rhabdomyosarcoma, IUGR/short stature, failure to thrive) and the reported parental recurrent miscarriages consistent with carrier parents.
